Question: For each \(x\) in \([0, 1],\) define \[ f(x) = \begin{cases} 2x, & 0 \le x \le \tfrac{1}{2},\\ 2 - 2x, & \tfrac{1}{2} \lt x \le 1. \end{cases} \] Let \(f^{[2]}(x) = f(f(x)),\) and \(f^{[n+1]}(x) = f^{[n]}(f(x))\) for each integer \(n \ge 2.\) For how many values of \(x\) in \([0, 1]\) is \(f^{[2005]}(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}?\)
